title: Sigurnost razvoja softvera
summary: SDLC i metodologije (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, SAFe, DevSecOps), CMM/SAMM, SSDF i SBOM, shift left; kontrole u razvojnom ekosistemu (memory-safe jezici, CI/CD, repozitoriji, SAST/DAST/IAST/RASP); efikasnost i rizik; nabavljeni softver (COTS, open source/SCA, cloud, escrow); sigurno kodiranje i API sigurnost.
summary_en: SDLC and methodologies (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, SAFe, DevSecOps), CMM/SAMM, SSDF and SBOM, shift left; controls in the development ecosystem (memory-safe languages, CI/CD, repositories, SAST/DAST/IAST/RASP); effectiveness and risk; acquired software (COTS, open source/SCA, cloud, escrow); secure coding and API security.
